semiconductor_relevance: Low — SYDEK primarily focuses on manufacturing trays and storage products, which are not core semiconductor components.
summary: SYDEK specializes in producing various types of trays for storage and handling, utilizing 3D printing and vacuum forming techniques. Their products cater to the needs of automated production lines, offering customizable options such as color-coded trays for sorting and storage.
capabilities: Vacuum-formed trays with lower mold costs
Customizable storage solutions with sorting features
